description: This file defines the SearchQueryBuilder interface, which provides a fluent API for constructing immutable SearchQuery objects. It includes methods for setting sorting options, pagination limits, and building the final SearchQuery.

classes.name: SearchQueryBuilder
classes.description: A mutable builder with a fluent API for constructing immutable SearchQuery instances, allowing configuration of sorting and pagination options.

methods.name: sortAsc
methods.description: Sets the sort order for the specified property path to ascending.

methods.name: sortDesc
methods.description: Sets the sort order for the specified property path to descending.

methods.name: removeSortOptionFor
methods.description: Removes the sort option for the given property path.

methods.name: limit
methods.description: Sets pagination limits with offset and count, with constraints on the maximum count.

methods.name: removeLimitation
methods.description: Removes any previously set pagination limits.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Constructs and returns an immutable SearchQuery based on the current configuration.
